parental-controls.answer: The stable parental-controls guide explains Kids Profile setup, restricted server identities and the household Parental PIN. Kids profiles disable external Discovery, not every mature title. The PIN protects restricted settings and switching from a Kids profile to a non-Kids profile. Switching between Kids profiles does not require the household PIN; a destination Profile Lock still protects entry. Library hiding is not account-wide access control, and shares have no server maturity filter. Standalone playlist approval requires the Kids profile, TV Sources authorization and a second PIN entry for Approve this source. It grants the whole source locally. IPTV accounts added through IPTV provider are automatically enrolled as server sources, which LiveTVSourceAuthorization.filtering does not filter; they have no standalone approval control. Enable only suitable accounts in Settings > Libraries and inspect channels and on-demand titles. Converting a standalone playlist does not transfer its approval protection. Use a restricted Seerr identity and check content, restrictions and automatic sign-in on every device. Connect a restricted Seerr account in optional profile setup: the ordinary Kids settings row is hidden. Enforced administrator blocking covers account sessions as well as unmapped API keys.

apple-tv-user-sign-in.answer: Select each Apple TV user, authorize the desired Plozz profile, then enable Settings > Profiles > Automatically Sign In. The shared roster and server sign-ins do not make active selection or the trusted startup session shared: those remain system-user-local and opt-in. Manual switches and changed trust still require authorization; this is not a name match or server-user creation. Plex Home's production-enabled offline sign-in proof uses nonsynchronizable, system-user-dependent Keychain storage, so an online sign-in under the current Apple TV user is required before locally verifying the unchanged saved Home-user PIN during a network failure. This is separate from the mobile Offline Mode toggle and cannot authorize a new binding or rejected credential. With automatic sign-in off, background browsing triggers profile selection on return immediately when any profile is locked or bound to a protected Plex user, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; one unlocked profile does not trigger it. Video/music/live playback, external-player departure and inactive-only interruptions do not trigger this browsing return check.

combined-library-browsing.answer: All Libraries pages enabled non-music libraries across accounts on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, preserving original-server ownership and merging matching identities where possible. More than one browsable library is required for its shortcut. All TV layouts support eligible shortcuts; mobile library shortcuts start hidden. In Screens & Navigation > App navigation > Hide or Reorder Navigation, hold All Libraries and choose Show, then open it from navigation. Compact native tabs can put it under More; the opaque bottom strip instead scrolls sideways. Individual mobile libraries can be shown there too; hiding shortcuts does not disable content. Choose an accessible copy through the title's server/version selector, in TV's header More actions when offered. Combined Home rows remain independent.

continue-watching-retention.answer: The Continue Watching row, including merged Next Up titles, does not impose an age or card-count cutoff on available history. This does not guarantee unlimited history retention: LocalMediaWatchStore keeps at most 2,000 newest records per profile/source store, fewer when needed to fit its payload budget. Old share resume positions and watched marks can therefore disappear as new history is saved. Provider queries and retained server history also determine available titles. ContinueWatchingPolicy.admits excludes trailers and invalid positions. Started videos need min(60, max(5, duration * 0.05)) seconds, or 60 seconds when duration is unknown; saved resume progress is independent. Zero-position episodes remain eligible as unstarted Next Up suggestions. Separate Next Up rows preview up to 20 titles, not the complete feed. Account-wide history queries ignore disabled library browsing switches, but watched/dismissal state, account inclusion and server-user authorization still apply. Include Next Up defaults on in Screens & Navigation > Home > Rows > Continue Watching; turn it off for separate rows. Removing Continue Watching suspends merging, while Continue Watching settings remains reachable in Rows.

alphabet-navigation.answer: In an Apple TV name-sorted title browse, scroll a few rows down to reveal the indexed letter rail and focus a letter to jump. Collection members and other sorts do not qualify. Combined or Silo jumps load on demand; select the letter again after a failed jump, or change sort away and back to name to rebuild a failed index. Mobile now has a wired All Libraries destination, but its grid still has feedback/destination hooks without a constructed alphabet menu or rail entry point. Use mobile filters, scrolling or Search instead.

top-shelf.answer: Put Plozz in Apple TV's top Home Screen row, then open Plozz, select a profile and load Home under each Apple TV system user. The canonical app and extension run as the current system user; the extension reads that user's app-group cache rather than fetching another user's Home or querying providers. Without a saved snapshot, the shelf has no media. From a non-Kids Plozz profile, Settings > Manage Plozz > Top Shelf offers default-on Show Top Shelf, Posters (default) or Full Screen and independent 1-20 Continue Watching/Recently Added counts, defaulting to four each. Full Screen expands with tvOS swipe-up; the first carousel action requests playback and the second opens details without autoplay. These actions have OS-owned captions, not verified app labels. Poster selection requests playback. Preferences stay device-local and shared among Plozz profiles, not an assurance of a shared snapshot between Apple TV system users; disabling clears media but retains choices. The saved Home snapshot is not live browsing; short feeds are not padded, same-source repeats deduplicate in Full Screen, and authorization/source failures remain visible. Artwork and full-screen spoilers respect profile policy.

community-skip-markers.answer: Enable Settings > Playback > Skip intros, credits & more, then open Customize. Default behavior offers Show skip button, Skip instantly or Skip after (1-30 seconds); Enable for controls movie/TV/anime eligibility. Each marker opens category-specific rules, including Off or Use default to restore the shared behavior. Disabled categories must first be enabled on the previous page. Actions need markers. With skipping enabled, Use community markers (default on) checks IntroDB/TheIntroDB when server intro or credits markers are missing, filling missing marker kinds without replacing server markers. Requests send movie/series IMDb, TMDB or TVDB IDs plus applicable episode coordinates, ordering, episode name and runtime, not video files. Matching and database availability limit coverage. Turning this off stops community requests, not server-provided markers.

dual-subtitles.answer: For movies and episodes, select primary text, then another text track through Apple TV Style > Dual Subtitles (or its direct control) or mobile Subtitles > Advanced… > Second Track; Off there removes only the second track. Live TV excludes dual subtitles. Mobile portrait starts in the ellipsis Playback options menu, while landscape separates controls. AetherEngine can decode embedded second text tracks; native playback needs fetchable text delivery. Image primaries disable dual mode and images cannot be second tracks. Image-primary placement is a separate supported control: Bottom of video can move eligible lower dialogue while preserving its original font, colors, image size and fixed artwork. Locally remuxed wireless AirPlay has no selectable subtitles.

library-channels.answer: Open Live TV's TV Sources > Plozz channels; enable the automatic lineup or Create custom channel. Automatic channels are not individually editable; Retry Plozz channels recovers preparation errors and Refresh Plozz channels rebuilds prepared lineups. For custom channels set the name, order and Movies/Episodes choices, then select accessible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby/Silo libraries and optional semicolon-separated rules. Allowed ratings matches normalized exact classifications, not a maximum age; Include unrated titles defaults on and admits missing classifications independently of that list. Movie-only ordering disables Episodes. Preview schedule before Save channel; missing/invalid durations exclude titles and blank fields allow all matches. Changes start after published programs. The library catalogue must finish syncing before devices can reproduce the same schedule. Update watch history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off; enabling it can mark programs watched after 90% actual viewing without resume writes. Both shells use the authorized completion mutation pipeline, so matching servers follow the cross-server history setting and connected video/anime trackers can receive eligible completions too. Playback uses original files, not IPTV or network-share sources. Silo requires allowed, available protocol-3 original_http support; its eligible single-file versions must have reliable duration/size and are revalidated before playback. Silo native Live TV remains a separate unsupported source type. Select a saved custom-channel name to edit; its Delete channel context action removes the channel without deleting library media.

offline-background.answer: On iPhone/iPad, choose Download from movie/episode details or Manage Seasons for available episodes. Review selection circles and open episode rows for versions: one recommended version starts selected, multiple episode versions save separate files, and movies allow one copy. Choose Versions adds a copy to a saved episode. Quality choices need support from all prepared items; Original Size requires known file sizes and Available shows device capacity. Ask Each Time defaults on; disabling it skips only single-item, single-version confirmation, never bulk/multiversion review. Streaming-service links are not downloadable. Wait for Downloaded in Downloads, not merely all bytes received or a Finishing Live Activity, and test video/audio/subtitles offline. While online, matching usable downloads can remain preferred after another server/version is selected. Offline Mode requires a saved copy of an explicitly selected version. Eligible HTTP transfers use background sessions; in-process/share transfers need the foreground unless continued processing is granted. Switching profiles pauses transfers; return to the owner to resume. iOS/iPadOS 26 Live Activities are optional and cancellation/expiry pauses work without deleting partial files. Network, speed, provider, storage and track limits still apply; Apple TV has no downloads. In Settings > Downloads, Offline Mode is the first feature-gated toggle; the profile picker's app-defined More menu offers it too. It is initially off, shared by profiles on this device and not synced. Enabling it pauses downloads, iCloud/network work and online tracking, replacing Home, library, Search and Watchlist content with authorized completed copies. Discover/Live TV cannot connect. Plex Home needs a prior online sign-in on this device for an unchanged binding, with any protected PIN checked locally; new identities and rejected credentials cannot use that proof. Turn the mode off and reconnect to retry saved progress updates. No Network Connection does not activate the mode; dismissing a notice changes no network or mode setting. New download settings use Use Cellular, Speed > Limit, In Background and Quality > Default/Ask Each Time. Original preserves embedded tracks. New reduced Plex/Emby/Silo copies retain all reported audio, though conversion can change formats and Emby preparation needs temporary space; Jellyfin may retain one audio track. Saved older preparations keep their original track choices on retry. Reduced Jellyfin and Emby preparations without all-audio support require Unlimited or Original, while new all-audio Emby transfers support the cap. Inclusion switches are absent. Completed video can remain usable after a sidecar warning. Update Subtitles/Retry Subtitles fetch sidecars without downloading video again, under foreground owner authorization and download network/rate policy. In a saved show, native Edit, Select All and Remove select and confirm deletion of local episode copies; Done clears selection. Top-level show menus retain Pause Show/Resume Show separately from season Pause/Resume. Kids profiles hide the Settings > Downloads shortcut; use Downloads > Download Settings or the profile picker’s More > Offline Mode instead.

cross-server-history.answer: Settings > Trackers > Sync across servers defaults on and propagates watched-state/resume updates to matching accessible copies. Apple TV places it under Watch status and disables it below two servers; mobile places it first on Trackers, not Playback. Turning it off keeps changes on the originating source. This is separate from iCloud configuration/profile sync, outgoing tracker reporting and optional experimental 2-way sync: incoming tracker history can update only explicitly selected media shares in Plozz, never Plex/Emby/Silo/Jellyfin history. Tracker activation and incoming-sync permission are device-local; source identities and authorization still govern delivery.

version-selection.answer: The first multi-version movie/episode asks How should versions be selected? Choose Ask every time, Choose automatically or Use first from server, and change it later under Settings > Playback > Version selection. During playback, Apple TV places Version inside More; mobile places it inside portrait Playback options or landscape Playback settings. Changing versions preserves the account and position, not timing alignment between different cuts. Automatic selection weighs resolution, HDR, bitrate and device compatibility; How automatic selection works explains the ranking. With Remember series version choices enabled, a matching remembered type takes priority in automatic mode and is preselected in ask mode. Missing types fall back to the device recommendation without promising identical episode files. Use first from server follows the selected account's version order, excludes external-service shortcuts and ignores remembered choices; an explicit title/player version choice still wins. On mobile while online, a usable matching download takes precedence over streaming even with another source/version selected; check the saved edition rather than assuming a source switch forces streaming. Offline Mode requires a saved copy of an explicitly selected version instead of substituting a different downloaded version.

device-setup.answer: Enable iCloud Sync starts first-run restoration; Not now leaves existing cloud data untouched. Retry repeats failed restoration; Set up manually pauses it until authorized setup finishes without turning sync off. Both platforms restore supported server/share sign-ins through encrypted ProviderCredentialSync records, not descriptors alone. Existing unowned sign-ins can trigger Save Sign-ins to iCloud? after setup: Save to iCloud permits publication to the verified current iCloud account; Keep on This Device declines that upload while settings still sync. Local sign-in under a verified iCloud identity records publication ownership; changing Apple Accounts does not automatically export sign-ins owned by the previous account. Generated-key shares and account-imported IPTV files are not portable. Silo requires bound protocol-2 enrollment and an unchanged PIN-free profile for automatic device authorization; otherwise complete its own sign-in. Nearby setup requires the same local network and Local Network permission: choose the receiver's platform-specific Set up from another device action, then send from the configured device's iCloud Sync page by nearby selection, code or QR. Scanning alone requires Camera permission. Compare codes when prompted; same-iCloud rendezvous can authenticate without comparison. Nearby transfer excludes Silo sign-ins and requires separate Silo approval. Needs sign-in identifies remaining setup; neither route bypasses source permissions or profile/Plex authorization. Supported profile-bound Seerr API keys can transfer; Seerr authenticated account sessions cannot and require sign-in on each device. Existing local connections are preserved.

App/PlozziOS/Info.plist.summary: Local Network permission supports discovery/pairing; Camera is used for setup QR scanning with code entry as an alternative. NSMotionUsageDescription explains device motion for Landscape auto: only the active authorized compact-phone full-screen player leases CoreMotion updates, allowing landscape direction changes even with system rotation lock enabled. Missing motion support falls back to system landscape rotation; this is not an iPad orientation picker or a guaranteed new permission prompt. Background audio/processing modes and download identifiers do not guarantee execution. Beta-only mobile Music wires the shared AudioPlaybackController's playback audio session and NowPlayingSession under the declared audio background mode, independently of the video's Background Audio preference; profile authorization still applies. The permitted external-stream.* identifier is wired through ExternalPlaybackExecution to an actual iOS/iPadOS 26 continued-processing grant, unavailable on tvOS/Catalyst. ExternalPlaybackRelay serves only authorized immutable regular share files and eligible SRT files over tokenized loopback URLs; it is not a LAN proxy or arbitrary upstream fetcher. Source/profile changes, grant expiry/cancellation, failure or returning Plozz to the foreground stop it. Custom apps, playlists, streaming-link/disc files and actual local downloads cannot use this relay. Infuse/VLC query schemes populate installed-player checks and the one-time Play in menu. The return URL routes through the mobile root and validated receipts into owner-authorized watch mutations, never arbitrary progress. Neither installation nor a background declaration bypasses source/launch eligibility.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.branded.entitlemen.omitReason: Side-by-side development builds intentionally omit canonical cloud and associated-domain capabilities; these internal provisioning variants are not consumer setup features.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.entitlements.summary: Canonical CloudKit/presence and pairing universal links are wired. Both shells restore supported provider/share credentials through a separate encrypted CloudKit credential channel gated by iCloud Sync consent; restoring server descriptors alone does not establish authentication. Mobile synchronizable Keychain remains a compatibility path, not the only credential-restoration route. Encrypted cloud transport cannot grant new source permissions or copy device-local parental/PIN authorization.

App/Resources/Info.plist.summary: The declared Guide-button activity is consumed by MainTabView only when Live TV is enabled, then opens the full-screen channel player's guide. Background audio uses the music controller and Now Playing session for screensaver listening and Control Center commands. External-app query schemes detect Native Player/Infuse/VLC; RootView routes the registered callback into nonce-, URL-, age- and authorization-validated receipts before AppState writes viewer-owned progress. External handoff is separate from AirPlay and Apple's in-app native engine. Native Player/Infuse/VLC scheme checks support the Apple TV detail Play in alternatives; Plozz can be chosen when another player is the default.

App/Resources/Plozz.branded.entitlements.omitReason: Empty entitlements belong to internal side-by-side development builds; production Apple TV user management and Top Shelf use the canonical entitlements instead.

App/Resources/Plozz.entitlements.summary: Canonical Apple TV capabilities support shared sign-ins and profile storage with system-user-local selection and opt-in automatic sign-in. The shared Plex Home model also keeps prior online-sign-in proof in nonsynchronizable, user-dependent Keychain storage: a network failure can permit local verification for the unchanged saved binding under this Apple TV user, without authorizing a new identity or rejected credentials. This does not expose the mobile Offline Mode toggle on Apple TV. CloudKit/push declarations do not establish dependable background execution: the root's foreground transition explicitly fetches enabled cloud sync. Canonical CloudKit composition also carries provider credentials in encrypted fields on both platforms, gated by iCloud Sync consent; entitlement comments describing configuration alone do not describe the separate implemented credential channel.

TopShelf/ContentProvider.swift.summary: The current-system-user extension renders the Home snapshot saved in that user's app-group cache, without provider/network calls or reading another Apple TV user's history. Each system user must open Plozz and load Home before their shelf has media. Full Screen has distinct playback and details actions with OS-owned captions; both resolve only within admitted active accounts. The adult settings entry controls default-on visibility, style and per-feed counts locally across Plozz profiles without broadening source permissions.

TopShelf/TopShelf.branded.entitlements.omitReason: This development-only Top Shelf extension deliberately lacks the canonical app group; it does not add a user-facing control or alternative setup procedure.

TopShelf/TopShelf.entitlements.summary: The canonical extension declares runs-as-current-user and the same app group used by the app's Home publisher. Its stored snapshot follows the Apple TV system user; shared app sign-ins/profile storage do not make a different system user's shelf a live data source. No additional permission prompt or extension sign-in procedure is exposed.

connections.summary: Connect supported media servers, approved Silo devices, IPTV accounts or wired share transports; shared sign-ins differ from profile library selection/server-user access. Manual Jellyfin/Emby checks prefer HTTPS, with eligible HTTP alternatives but no downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS rejection. Choose later defers initial library selection without declaring failed discovery empty. Libraries > Watching as or mobile identity controls select existing users; adding another sign-in does not create server users. Sign In Again validates the original account/server/profile without deleting a connection on failure/cancellation. Manage only trusted verified alternate addresses; HTTP is unencrypted, Silo reapproves and Tailscale needs manual entry on an already-connected playback device. WebDAV folder browsing does not establish seekable playback: the network-share section explains byte ranges and file-change metadata, direct versus anonymous HTTPS delivery requirements, credential isolation, administrator checks and rescan/reopen after replacing files. Shared Sources > Add Source navigation replaces separate server/share add actions. IPTV guide preparation is independent of channel availability and has explicit status/recovery in the channel guide.

library.summary: Search has a dedicated reader workflow: results update with the query, mobile Clear search removes text, and Cancel search also dismisses the keyboard. Seerr search is separate from Discover-page filters. Browse, filter, sort and search enabled libraries; All Libraries combines them on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, with explicit mobile shortcut visibility explained in the combined-library capability. Only Apple TV exposes the name-sort letter rail. Genre/year intersect quick filters; preparation, interrupted collections and failed facets retain cancellation/retry paths, including the exact Couldn't load filter options. Try Again menu action. Eligible Home row previews open a row-specific grid, not an unrestricted library query: TV uses a trailing See all card and mobile a heading chevron. Combined Recently Added, collection members and server recommendations retain their actual feeds; filter/sort changes load the remaining feed before publishing results, with Retry on failure. Watchlist shortcuts open the dedicated page and its saved preferences instead. Upcoming is a separate personal calendar on all platforms, not Discover's broad forthcoming-title feeds: history-bearing shows, in-progress movies, Watchlist movies/shows and the selected Seerr account’s own pending/approved movie/show requests supply known dates. Its guide explains date selection, regional digital releases, filters, title hiding/restore and failed refreshes; Coming Soon opens that calendar instead of a row grid. Hidden titles affect both surfaces locally per profile, while calendar filters do not affect Home. Dates do not promise a playable copy. Dedicated Discover is a separate non-Kids destination with five ordered paged feeds, not Home's hero or its See all grids. Available now requires a currently validated playable copy in enabled accessible libraries and hides both upcoming feeds; Hide watched uses known completion history. Both filters default off, save per profile, and offer Clear Filters; row failures offer Try Again. Seerr can supply feeds but is not required for browsing, and requesting does not grant playback. Collections, playlists, extras, IPTV on-demand catalogues and source/version selection remain distinct from requests and schedule-only placeholders. Watchlist covers save/removal, filters, date/name sorting, profile ownership and connected-list effects; disabling sources does not erase explicit saves. History actions distinguish watched-state changes from Continue Watching dismissal/resume clearing and cross-server delivery. Library tabs and Recommended rows differ from Home/main shortcuts; Browse is the fallback, shares lack Recommended, and collection-cover shapes have independent library/row scopes. Server-owned trailers/previews play in Plozz; Watch on YouTube opens externally regardless of external-player preference, requiring the TV app or mobile app/web fallback without guaranteeing availability. The Watch extras section explains source-dependent bonus videos, row retry, supported resuming and device/profile-local Plex fallback progress. Extras/trailers do not complete the main title, fan out to matching copies or scrobble trackers; trailers never enter Continue Watching. Share history persists locally per profile/device; dismissing a share preserves its resume position, and later playback can restore its card. Detail information supports full readers for truncated descriptions, facts and overflowing groups; Apple TV Back and mobile Done/close differ. Selected-file facts are not runtime diagnostics, and catalogue episode/season totals are not available/unwatched counts. Trailers & music now provides one shared profile destination for trailer-source policy, independent Home autoplay and detail Trailer/Theme music/Off choices. Server files from another accessible matching copy are preferred before external YouTube; policy Off removes trailer actions/autoplay while preserving non-trailer extras and theme music. Eligible Apple TV previews expand through Up with ordinary transport and temporary sound; Home requires Pinned Sidebar. Both shells register visible Home/detail surfaces for lifecycle refresh. Home requests reloading on app foreground return; in-app returns refresh after 15 seconds. Series returns after 300 seconds refresh season/episode context, while movie/episode returns refresh watch state only. Mobile Manage Seasons includes Refresh Episodes and Season Status for current library availability without treating metadata-only episode rows as downloadable. Movie All + Name browsing preserves each supported server’s inline collection grouping; collection members remain separate destinations. Person pages place Known for before owned-library credits; biography expansion and unowned-title limits are explained.

home-navigation.summary: Screens & Navigation separates Home hero/style, Card labels, Rows, Filtering, shortcuts and movie/show details. Presets replace arrangements after confirmation without editing servers. Add row > Custom row opens Content, Name, Sort, Filter, Layout and conditional Logo before a non-playing preview. Content can combine multiple collections, video playlists, whole libraries, Home feeds and recommendations from enabled accessible video sources; server-bound choices preserve user identity. The focused custom-row guide explains selection, Source order interleaving and matching-copy merging, full-feed loading for alternate sort/filter, layouts, explicit new-row saving, TV existing-row autosave versus mobile Save changes and unavailable-source recovery. Only a sole Watchlist source uses save dates for Date Added. Plain combined Continue Watching does not acquire a larger-grid shortcut from its count, but an explicitly created custom row can select its feed. Expanded grids start with a custom row's saved query; temporary browse changes do not rewrite Home. Shared controls now use Media, Watch status, conditional Clear Filters and Source order; Order is hidden without a sort field. Classic/mobile empty messages expose Dismiss and Customize Home; dismissal hides the message, not future content, and Rows > the row > Show empty message reverses it outside Showcase. Failed/unavailable rows retain Details/Retry. History ignores library-browsing switches: eligible Continue Watching/merged Next Up has no age/count cap, separate Next Up previews up to 20, brief-play eligibility differs from saved resume, and trailers stay out. Coming Soon previews Upcoming releases; its See all action opens the calendar, not a row grid. The calendar's filters leave that row unchanged, while hiding a title affects both. Upcoming has its own shown/hidden navigation shortcut and calendar/filter controls rather than being a Discover feed. Recently Added and Hero & discovery filters have separate defaults/candidate limits and change suggestions, not access. Showcase is independent of the hero, shares its rating settings but has separate sizes, and can manage Discovery with the hero off. Discovery needs no Seerr for browsing; a new profile's carousel follows that connection until explicitly changed and Kids policy excludes Discovery. TV layouts all support eligible library shortcuts. Mobile defaults show Home, Upcoming, Downloads and Search; Hidden/Show and native More concern navigation, not library access. On iOS/iPadOS 26+ with app Liquid Glass Off, system Reduce Transparency off and no active sidebar/vertical toolbar, an opaque scrolling bottom strip replaces native tabs; scroll sideways for overflow instead of using More. System Reduce Transparency keeps native navigation. TV sidebars retain Settings and Top Bar has a profile-picker route. Reset Navigation preserves names, library tabs and access. Layout/shortcuts stay device-local; Home rows and names can transfer/sync. Ordinary row names use Row name, custom rows use Name, shortcuts use Rename > Name; blank restores defaults. TV saves names when the keyboard closes, including Back; mobile uses Save changes. Watchlist shares its Home-row and shortcut name. Hero and Movie & show details share Trailers & music with independent Home/detail choices. Apple TV Upcoming embeds an always-available week strip: Previous week/Next week change the displayed week, date selection moves the agenda, and Calendar opens the month jump. The selectable interval stays today through 90 days ahead; mobile keeps its month calendar and 30-day history.

appearance.summary: Keep theme/cards/language orientation in Appearance, with a focused artwork guide for source selection, per-view scope, localized posters and missing download pictures. Artwork > Customize by view offers per-area Library/Metadata providers choices, plus Mixed for title details; selecting another preset replaces overrides. Apple TV's contextual help illustrations are reachable and informational, not an omitted destination. Customize labels selects Page; Home/Recommended have page Default plus row Overrides. Mixed hides captions on series artwork and in TV Showcase. Continue Watching's Use default inherits its context; On/Off applies to both Home and Recommended. Home Libraries has its own override; contextual editors share the same preference store and collection/playlist members use Browse. On Apple TV only, Page > Movie & show details offers Only show descriptions on focus after Episodes; it defaults off, needs episode labels on and collapses unfocused episode synopses without relaxing spoiler policy. Watch indicators distinguish unstarted flags, completed checks and Hidden, separately from episode counts, count style and Show progress bars. Hiding marks/bars neither changes history nor clears resume; these profile-owned settings are transfer-allowlisted. Retain Liquid Glass, independent header sizes, profile artwork versus shared metadata sources, saved download artwork, and interface language versus media language/device region. Interface language also requests localized external metadata/biographies where supported, with original/English fallback; server/NFO text is unchanged. Provider-specific poster locale/fallback evidence is recorded in MetadataKit and Language; download repair is recorded on the Downloads screen. The non-English Language feedback action is a separate GitHub translation report, not mobile Help & Diagnostics email.

spoilers.summary: Spoiler Protection remains in Screens & Navigation > All screens, with platform labels, blur/placeholder, in-progress image/text differences, chapter masking and independently hidden/revealable review scores. Home > Rows > Continue Watching owns Artwork + logo/Thumbnail/Poster, Playback details and Labels; only Thumbnail uses episode stills. Labels uses Use default for contextual inheritance, with On/Off shared across Home/Recommended. Progress only removes playback text but bars still respect the profile's independent Show progress bars preference. Hidden rows retain settings and Add row recovery. Center button action on Apple TV and Tap action on iPhone/iPad default to Open detail page when no choice is saved; saved Play or Open detail page choices remain intact. Play starts the title, and TV Play/Pause always remains direct. Presentation changes neither watched state nor membership.

circadian.summary: Set solar-region, manual or always-on dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview a day, disable the effect, and separate profile-owned app tint from system or TV settings.

playback.summary: Use remote/mobile controls and same-account versions with Ask every time, Choose automatically or Use first from server; the third mode preserves server order and ignores independent series memory. Ask to resume or start over is a separate opt-in control: Resume shows remaining time and Start Over full runtime when known, independently of resume rewind. The shared prompt is wired through TV and mobile hosts without dropping the pending request. Keep autoplay, Up Next, marker/category rules and community privacy limits. Player tabs orders default-on Chapters, Cast, Episodes, Playlist and Continue Watching per profile, still requiring available content; Info is retained. Continue Watching uses loaded Home progress, excludes the current title and same-source show episodes, and switches to the selected authorized source/version and position. Song recognition defaults on per profile, uses Shazam and decoded playback audio rather than the microphone, and needs internet and a supported route; Offline Mode, native playback and remote bypass cannot supply it. Every match card opens Open song with Spotify search, conditional Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and TIDAL searches. TV universal-link failure shows a phone QR code; mobile opens an app/browser. The focused song guide distinguishes recognition from service access and library music. Chapters needs usable source/file chapters; images are optional and cast-page navigation ends playback. Eligible videos use a per-platform saved default, initially Normal; Auto-crop black bars is opt-in; explicit zoom choices persist per profile for a movie or series and can follow strongly matched copies across servers. Live channel changes restore that platform default with no per-channel memory; sampling still requires supported local playback, not AirPlay/PiP. The external-player reference explains compatible original/converted streams from supported servers, eligible on-demand IPTV and share routes, mobile quality limits, token/password sharing, fallback and authorized progress returns. Mobile share relay requires a real OS continued-processing grant and stops on foreground return, cancellation/expiry or authorization changes. Network-share BDMV folders add profile-level Disc playback and a held detail play-button alternative. HDMV menus use directions/select and explicit return/close actions, Retry and region recovery; production does not support BD-J menus. Disc videos lists dynamic numbered playlists with durations/chapters, starts selected entries at zero, and invalidates after source changes. Menu/selected-playlist playback suppresses title progress, history, trackers, skipping and autoplay; Play video restores ordinary viewing. Held Play in is one-time, not a new default.

quality.summary: Set profile-owned mobile network defaults or a session limit through Quality in portrait Playback options or landscape Playback settings. Presets apply immediately; Advanced… opens the sheet with Quality limit, Transcoding codec, Force transcoding and Apply. Maximum removes the app's reduction limit, not server compatibility decisions; lower limits permit originals only with fitting known dimensions/bitrate, otherwise conversion can be required. Custom limits take a supported resolution and whole-number total Kbps; invalid saved limits must be replaced rather than treated as Maximum. HEVC preference can fall back to H.264 at the same limit except for Silo, whose conversion is H.264 with mono/stereo AAC and supported height/bitrate limits. Playing in SDR identifies an SDR conversion; Current stream uses active facts, Declared stream bitrate is not throughput, and missing facts remain Not available. Preserve server permission/capacity and forced-conversion recovery. Compatible converted streams can hand off to an external player; mobile quality limits remain in the preparation request rather than being bypassed. Native routes with separate audio or incompatible authorization still stay in Plozz. Device-local Video buffer applies on new sessions across all platforms, not quality/downloads, with space/native-path limits; Live TV buffer is a separate cushion, not recording.

audio.summary: Select tracks/language. A manually chosen movie language is remembered automatically per profile; series memory needs Remember audio language per series. Memory stores language, not an exact commentary track, codec or mix, and can follow strongly matched movies/series across servers. Playback > Audio exposes default-on Prefer lossless audio in both shells. Turning it off requests AetherEngine's compressed surround-compatible output, useful for regular HDMI ARC. The adapter samples it for on-demand/live loads, not native-engine or external-app playback; reopen video/retune after changes. Actual output depends on source/equipment. It is shared across Plozz profiles on this device and excluded from sync/transfer. The same Audio page includes profile-owned, default-on Identify songs. Its reader task is answered in playback's song-identification section and linked from Audio: ShazamKit consumes played audio, never the microphone, and needs internet, Offline Mode off and a decoded-audio-capable route. A match appears with Info; an Apple Music URL is optional and requires that service's access. Explain capability-gated AetherEngine Audio Sync, its TV/mobile paths, positive-later/negative-earlier sign, Reset, ±10-second video and ±2-second live ranges, per-stream reset and possible seek/reload interruptions; retain opt-in mobile Background Audio/data use, and output-gated TV Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue with system-wide scope and Settings recovery. Screens & Navigation > Movie & show details > Trailers & music > Details > Detail background > Theme music plays through the shared controller on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. Theme music volume is 0%-100%; adjusting it can preview automatically and Play preview/Stop preview provide explicit control. Preview resolution checks authorized Home titles, then can use a generated sample if none supplies a theme; a preview is not universal title availability. Leaving the page stops the preview. Detail music fades in/out, pauses outside the app, and yields to trailers/full playback. The mobile detail speaker button toggles Mute theme music/Unmute theme music only during active detail playback; session mute changes neither saved volume nor Settings previews and resets on leaving that detail. Off selects static detail art independently of Home trailers and video tracks. Trailer-source Off does not disable theme music; Home autoplay and video tracks are independent. The Select a language or track section explains original track names, conditional Commentary and Audio Description choices, and source-format labels versus actual speaker output.

subtitles.summary: Select/search tracks, distinguish forced/SDH and per-content policies, enter mobile language codes or follow device language, style text or Live TV, and manage second tracks. Mobile Subtitles > Advanced… contains Second Track, Subtitle Delay and Appearance > Style; Search & Download… opens search separately. Portrait starts in Playback options. Search needs account permission and configured server providers; unavailable/incomplete searches are not empty results. Expired results require another search; uncertain downloads require checking the track list before retry. Silo acquisition is bound to the active item/file/play session. Prefer SDH permits fallback; Only SDH makes automatic/search/download choices strict without overriding manual or remembered choices. Matching device caption style replaces custom appearance after confirmation; appearance edits leave matching, but changes only to control avoidance or ASS/SSA override preserve it. Position selects Bottom of screen or Bottom of video, and Vertical offset measures upward from that reference; Extra Line Position offers Above/Center/Below for wrapped-line growth, not second-track placement. Default-on Auto-Move Away from Controls follows those placement controls in both editors, lifts colliding Plozz-rendered text/eligible image captions while controls are visible, and returns them when controls disappear; disabling allows overlap. The picture-placement section retains active-picture detection with video-frame fallback and lower-dialogue image movement preserving size/fixed artwork. Use your style instead of file formatting explains source-position/color/font choices and the default-off ASS/SSA override, available only in ordinary video Settings, not in-player or Live TV style. It replaces authored signs/karaoke where Plozz draws captions; turn it off to restore them because Reset to App Default preserves the override. Change appearance explains the platform-specific sample preview navigation. Explain embedded AetherEngine versus fetchable native text, image-primary exclusion, secondary Off, timing and AirPlay limits. External apps receive eligible fetchable SRT sidecars without Plozz styling/dual guarantees; custom templates receive no subtitle links. Choose a track explains retained source-authored names for same-language versions and the auto qualifier for an inferred language, not translated captions.

music.summary: Music uses enabled authorized Plex/Jellyfin/Emby libraries on Apple TV and beta-only iPhone/iPad. PlozziOSAppModel constructs its runtime only for development/TestFlight release channels, not production; mobile Offline Mode forbids the destination. Browse Playlists, Albums, Artists and Genres; Play/Shuffle or a track replaces the queue and opens the player. The TV current-track card scrolls in the page header; the mobile compact dock spans navigation and expands on tap. Mobile Queue exposes past History and upcoming tracks, selecting/reordering plus section-specific Clear; this history is not server listening history. More actions retains source-qualified album/artist navigation, Clear Up Next and Stop Playing. Plex ratings and Jellyfin/Emby favorites write to the selected server user, omit unsupported feedback and roll back failed writes with visible errors. Background audio is traced through the shared controller, system-command session and each platform's Info.plist; mobile music does not depend on the video Background Audio preference. FLAC direct playback is provider-wired but not a promise of unchanged hardware output. Music has no offline-download workflow. LRCLIB receives title, artist, album and duration, never audio. The TV lyrics toggle gates future lookup; the mobile Lyrics button only changes panel visibility and timed lines seek. The engine admits synchronized lyrics only despite reusable plain-text rendering. Last.fm observer wiring exists in the TV shell, not the mobile runtime; mobile must not promise scrobbling. Music player appearance has TV Screens & Navigation versus beta-mobile Appearance entry points, with Match App Theme, Artwork, Black, Dark and Light in picker order. Match follows gradients and palette; overrides affect the full player, not browsing or the mobile dock. Extra track-information display is TV-only. Beta provider pickers on both platforms expose Navidrome (Subsonic). The connection is music-only, with explicit address, username and Password/API Key selection; API keys need server support. The provider implements browse, playback and server favorites; listening reports go directly to the Subsonic server independently of Last.fm. Completed listens require a track longer than 30 seconds and at least min(duration/2, 240) actual seconds on stop.

live-tv.summary: Set up IPTV or server channels using direct M3U catalogues rather than web pages or single-stream HLS. EPG URL (optional) accepts XMLTV; Advanced options adds guides, authentication and separate playlist/stream versus guide headers. Guide headers apply to the first guide URL's server; empty fields follow playlist credentials. Prefer HTTPS. Distinguish device-local IPTV account file imports from encrypted standalone source-copy sync. Current IPTV accounts expose Refresh guide and household Sources > Edit connection, not standalone Playlist and guides, guide mapping, identity repair or availability scans. Standalone Kids approvals grant the whole playlist locally; IPTV accounts are enrolled as server sources and do not use that approval, so account selection and content review remain essential. Connect as IPTV account preserves the older source/preferences but not its approval protection on the new account; disable the duplicate source afterward. Live TV opens to chooses Categories or Guide; Channel order and Guide preferences > Recently watched affect browsing, not source access. These view choices stay profile/device-local. Category overrides, country-OR-language filtering, individual hiding and scan exclusions have distinct recovery paths. Identity restoration requires same-station/feed confirmation and carries favorites, hiding and mappings. Guide retention is not recording. Search tunes live rather than replaying a program. Multiview supports four pictures subject to provider limits, with focus-selected audio on Apple TV and Audio on mobile. TV first-use offers Turn on previews/Keep previews off; later Auto preview and Keep watching while browsing are TV-only, while Preview after watching is shared. Mobile network restrictions react to detected changes and may briefly use cellular; Low Data Mode pauses Live TV even on Wi-Fi. Library channels admit eligible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby/Silo originals, not native Silo TV. Automatic channels offer Retry/Refresh but are not individually editable. Custom channels need valid durations, exact-rating rules and explicit handling of unrated titles; schedules wait for already-scheduled programs and catalogue sync. History is default-off, profile-scoped and device-local; 90%-viewed completions use normal cross-server/tracker updates without resume writes. Live TV buffer trades tuning latency for a new-load cushion, respects Jump to live, and is not recording or buffering for scheduled library files. Authorized account guide updates report stage progress across navigation; dismissing is not cancellation, and Guide ready does not promise every channel/date.

offline.summary: On iPhone/iPad, review available episodes/versions and quality, wait for Downloaded and test video/audio/subtitles offline. Ask Each Time does not suppress bulk or multiversion review. Online playback can prefer a usable matching download; Offline Mode needs the explicitly selected version saved. Settings order is Offline Mode, Network, Speed, Quality, Notifications, In Progress and Storage. Original preserves embedded tracks; new reduced Plex/Emby/Silo copies retain all reported audio, though formats can change and Emby preparation needs temporary space. Jellyfin reduced copies may retain one audio track. Saved older preparations keep their track choices on retry, and reduced Jellyfin/some Emby copies cannot use a speed cap. New all-audio Emby transfers support caps. No new-download audio/subtitle inclusion switches exist. Supported text sidecars have per-file, total-size and count limits; partial warnings keep usable video. Downloads and saved-show episode menus offer Update Subtitles/Retry Subtitles without retransferring video, requiring the foreground authorized owner, online mode and download network/rate policy. Old preparations excluding text omit it. In a saved show, native Edit opens episode selection, Select All and Remove allow confirmed bulk deletion, and Done clears selection. Season controls remain separate from top-level Pause Show/Resume Show. Background HTTP differs from in-process/share work; iOS 26 continued processing is an OS decision and Finishing is incomplete. Activity cancellation/profile switches pause work and retain partial files. Bulk cancellation deletes unfinished copies; Delete All Downloads removes this profile's saved videos, never server originals. Completion notices open authorized details without autoplay. Offline Mode is shared on this device, pauses transfers/online services and restricts Home/libraries/Search/Watchlist to authorized usable copies. Plex Home needs prior online sign-in for its unchanged binding and retains protected PIN checks. Dismissing a notice changes neither mode nor connectivity; reconnect with the mode off for pending history updates. Apple TV has no downloads.

profiles.summary: Separate app profiles/server users/Apple TV system users, mobile editing/switching, profile locks/Plex PIN reuse and automatic startup trust. With TV automatic sign-in off, background browsing returns to selection immediately if any profile is protected, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; playback/handoff and inactive-only interruptions are exempt. Choose a Jellyfin/Emby sign-in or Plex Home user in Libraries through TV Watching as or mobile picker/identity rows. Plex identity also selects whose Watchlist is read and written. Explicitly choosing Don't use this server's watchlist excludes that contribution, not browsing/playback; disable and re-enable the server in Libraries to reconsider and choose a user. Do not equate every mobile sheet dismissal with an explicit decline. Add Another User/Add Another Plex Account authenticates an existing identity, adding shared device credentials rather than creating a server user. Confirm the identity/libraries and honor Plex PIN checks. Add your Plex Home profiles? offers Add all profiles or Just me on both platforms. Profiles added/Profiles ready advances automatically to Choose your profile after import; Just me opens Choose your Plex user with Back available. Bulk import creates or reuses profiles by existing Home-user binding, not a display-name match; only the selected viewer proceeds through authorization/setup. Other imported profiles remain awaiting setup, not unlocked or automatically Kids. Kids Profile and the household Parental PIN require separate configuration. Library discovery switches do not remove account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up or impose server maturity restrictions. A household PIN enforces Kids settings/switching and Seerr admin-request gates. Kids playlist sources stay blocked until a PIN exists and each source is approved on that device, independently of general Kids-restriction enforcement. Approvals are whole-source, local and identity-bound, not ratings filtering. No forgotten-PIN reset is wired; another device must already permit unlocked editing to remove a synced lock.

sync.summary: Distinguish iCloud configuration, encrypted server/share and tracker sign-ins, provider-limited nearby transfer and server authorization. First-run consent gates automatic sync; Not now leaves cloud data untouched. Restoration exposes progress, Retry and Set up manually; manual setup pauses restoration until setup completes while sync stays enabled. Both shells restore supported credentials through ProviderCredentialSync. Silo enrolls a separate session only when its server supports bound protocol-2 enrollment and the saved Silo profile has no PIN; otherwise sign-in and approval remain required. Apple TV fetches enabled cloud sync on foreground rather than relying on background delivery. Explain network/permission/code-verification requirements and separate cross-server history. Default-on cross-server history mirrors eligible normal-title changes only to matching accessible copies; extras/trailers remain origin-only and do not emit tracker history. Queued failures retry with the captured original profile/server identities authorized; local card changes do not prove every server accepted an update. Share progress and Plex-extra fallback records persist per profile/account/viewer on the current device, not through iCloud configuration sync. Watchlist filters and sort order are transferable profile preferences, separately from membership; the allowlisted WatchlistBrowsePreferencesStore key travels with profile snapshots. Display Size, navigation style and main shortcut arrangement stay local per profile, as does Apple TV accidental-exit prevention, rather than syncing or transferring; library-tab order does transfer. Downloads/startup/Video buffer/Live TV buffer/Top Shelf remain local too. Prefer lossless audio stays local across Plozz profiles and is excluded from transfer because it depends on connected equipment. Diagnostics consent is neither synced nor transferred and is not profile-owned. External-player selection is device-wide and local; returned progress stays with the authorized original viewer/server. Live TV source copies sync encrypted per profile; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local, schedules need snapshots, and legacy source import differs from account import. Refresh Breakdown shows encoded local payload/count snapshots, not iCloud storage: include pending uploads/catalogue schedules; exclude pending deletions/downloaded IPTV guides and separate Keychain/Trakt records. On all three platforms iCloud Sync > Troubleshooting offers Reload From iCloud and destructive Reset Sync; distinguish downloading shared settings from replacing them with this device's copy. Retain erase/re-upload prevention and mobile Keychain erasure. Transferable presentation preferences grant neither access nor unsupported modes. Seerr cookie sessions are not copied. Supported profile-bound API keys use approved secret transfer or the mobile Keychain path, preserve configured local connections and require capable receiving apps. Trackers > Sync across servers is now the sole visible cross-server control location on both platforms. Tracker activation and explicit incoming share-history permissions are device-local, distinct from synced tracker credentials; optional 2-way sync does not turn local share history into an iCloud data type.

tracking.summary: Connect profile-owned eligible video/anime/music accounts, including PublicMetaDB browser pairing/manual key on TV and secure mobile key entry. Use <service> pauses device-local reporting without disconnecting or removing connected Watchlist destinations. Video reporting admissions fence stale queued activity across pauses. Saved incoming-history permission is retained while reporting is paused and can resume afterward; it is not revoked by hiding its controls. Optional experimental 2-way sync brings existing and new supported history into explicitly selected media shares only; managed-server history is not an incoming destination. Explain foreground/Offline Mode conditions, watched-only anime scope, matching/runtime limits, conflict preservation, deferred playback, Sync now, visible failures and unconfirmed-write holds. Key replacement/disconnect can affect the profile's synced devices without revoking a remote PublicMetaDB key. Generic reviewed imports/exports, Last.fm history browsing and PublicMetaDB account-management tools lack production entry points; do not infer availability from backend readers or account-tool views. Existing outgoing external-return Trakt and Watchlist behavior remain separate, with module and task-specific evidence.

requests.summary: Select the active profile and connect a trusted Seerr server with an offered authenticated-user sign-in or an authorized administrator API key. Existing media-account reuse differs from manual identity confirmation. Saved connections, Default account, Use last account and Ask each time control browsing and request destinations; failures never switch silently. Session requests use their authenticated user; API-key Request as selects an authorized restricted user or unrestricted Admin. Kids administrator blocking requires the household Parental PIN. Requests add media through Seerr, not offline downloads; season status/actions and Release & Availability remain separate from playback ownership. Upcoming includes this profile’s own pending/approved movie and TV requests, alongside watched/in-progress and saved titles. Account sessions remain device-local; supported profile-bound API keys can transfer without replacing configured local connections.

metadata.summary: Explain shared metadata priorities/disablement, local TMDB credential verification, profile artwork choices and source/build-dependent review scores. Mobile Screens & Navigation > Movie & show details > Rating sources & order enables individual header score sources; SwiftUI Edit/Done changes priority through list reordering. The profile's enabled sources and maximum count constrain available scores. AniList remains anime-only. Provider-display scores retain server sortRank rather than the custom priority. Jellyfin details can prefer valid cached MDBList Ratings plugin scores in server-supplied order, without a new Plozz key/toggle or upstream refresh; absent/failed/invalid results retain ordinary enrichment. Home can reuse already-cached plugin ratings. Emby does not use this API. Show content ratings is a default-on profile setting under Screens & Navigation > All screens; turning it off hides classifications on Home/details/Top Shelf, not review scores or Common Sense guidance, and never enforces access restrictions. Common Sense detail requires viewing-account Plex Pass. Shares support matching video-stem NFO, show-root tvshow.nfo and named local artwork after rescan/metadata work, subject to unambiguous supported associations and artwork policy. Cache clearing affects lookup data/derived images, not downloads or server matching. External-title Release & Availability shows device-region releases and TMDB/JustWatch offers, independently of Seerr, playable ownership and subscriptions; missing offers do not prove unavailability.

help.summary: Keep symptom checks and reset/cache scopes non-destructive. Incomplete library results offer Details/Try Again, while Home row statuses offer Details/Retry without discarding saved choices; No streams found rechecks inventory, not playback. Restore saved sign-ins without deleting connections; Plex Home can require the original account, not a PIN reset. Cover Discord/GitHub/mobile email, duplicate checks and safe reproduction/device/source details. Startup diagnostics choices both continue; reporting defaults off and needs current consent plus a configured endpoint. Share Diagnostics is device-wide, not profile-owned or transferred. Send Diagnostics offers Enable Sharing when off; consenting enables reporting without submitting the manual report. Both platforms then use Message (required) and Send to Developer; blank messages disable Send and CrashDiagnostics rejects them. Automatic Sentry reports include fixed screen categories/performance evidence but exclude identity/server/media/history. Explicit submissions include allowlisted activity, search, connection, preparation, failed-library-load and retained playback/source evidence, not free-form Recent Activity messages. Search evidence excludes query text, names and URLs. The submitted message is sent as written, so exclude secrets and personal details. Export aliases are scoped to one submission. Mobile Refresh/filter/search/Copy exports an activity summary without message text, whereas local display, manual text selection and screenshots can expose server/content details. Submitted confirms SDK handoff, not receipt or a public issue. Privacy Policy is reachable in consent/Settings, with a TV QR handoff. Apple TV Home Performance Overlay is wired through MainTabView/HomeView and exposes FPS, hitches and thermal state for stutter reports; the mobile toggle has no Home renderer consumer, so do not promise a mobile overlay. Local error details need no upload consent. Settings > Release Notes remains reachable after startup notices are disabled. Show release notes on startup for new versions and the confirmed Don’t Show Again action control automatic notices, not manual access. Shared Sources > Add Source navigation replaces separate server/share add actions. IPTV guide preparation is independent of channel availability and has explicit status/recovery in the channel guide. Language > Send Feedback is a non-English-only GitHub translation-report path, with an Apple TV QR presentation; it is distinct from Help & Diagnostics > Send Feedback email.

platforms.summary: Explain remote/touch/keyboard, VoiceOver, optional gestures, iPhone full-window orientation versus iPad system rotation, and TV fades that do not enable system matching. Player orientation choices are Follow device orientation, Portrait, Landscape auto, Landscape left and Landscape right. Follow device orientation respects system rotation lock; Landscape auto uses the active phone player's motion lease to follow sideways direction even with rotation lock enabled, with fixed choices retaining their direction. Trace NSMotionUsageDescription and the runtime full-window/phone checks rather than treating an entitlement or label as proof of iPad support. Mobile pinch changes cutout-safe framing while in Auto-crop and switches Normal/Crop otherwise. The picture guide explains separate saved iPhone/iPad/Apple TV defaults, remembered movie/series overrides and live channel reset to the platform default. Link Apple TV's automatic-sign-in and background-browsing return checks, distinct from playback departures and brief inactive interruptions. Top Shelf offers shared local adult controls, Posters/Full Screen and 1-20 counts defaulting four; source-scoped snapshots retain authorization/spoiler limits. Trace Guide OS entry and music Now Playing commands. Distinguish live seeking/Jump to live from library-channel Jump to now and recording. Live TV buffer applies on new live stream loads, not library files, and Jump to live retains its latency/tuning tradeoffs. Conversion diagnostics separate active video/audio facts from original-source details; neither establishes physical speaker layout. Throughput is not encoded bitrate and temporary cache is not downloads. Retain remuxed AirPlay subtitle loss, Multiview/PiP limits and authorized external-player returns.

AniListService.summary: Connected-account activation pauses reporting locally without removing Watchlist destinations. Optional 2-way sync can bring watched-only anime history into explicitly selected media shares, not managed servers. Aggregate show episode counts do not identify individual watched episodes. Reviewed bulk import/export views have no production entry point.

FeatureAuth.summary: Keep provider sign-in and verified alternate addresses in the server task. Saved-account Sign In Again is wired in both shells for Jellyfin/Plex/Emby/Silo/Navidrome (Subsonic), validates the original account/server/profile and replaces credentials without deleting the saved connection; cancellation/failure preserves it. Navidrome's add-source entry is beta-only; its reauthentication view retains the address and username and asks for a password or API key. Network retry and IPTV/share connection editing remain separate. Plex Home recovery reauthenticates the original Plex account before the intended user's normal access/PIN checks, not a PIN reset.

FeatureDiscovery.summary: Use LAN discovery or manual entry; Jellyfin/Emby public checks prefer HTTPS, try eligible HTTP alternatives before authentication and stop rather than downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS trust rejection. The same resolver is wired through the shared picker model into mobile AddServerView. Saved routes keep exact-address behavior. Tailscale is an externally configured connection requiring the server's IP/MagicDNS address, not a Plozz-managed VPN or discoverable LAN server.

FeatureHome.summary: Keep browsing, collection recovery, source/version selection, Watchlists and schedule-only placeholders together. Both shells resolve All Libraries through FeatureHomeCore's shared source inventory/merge policy; mobile has a reachable navigation destination but still no alphabet rail. Home row browsing is a separate reachable workflow: eligible TV See all cards/mobile headings open the original row feed through HomeRowBrowseFactory, while Watchlist routes to its existing page. Coming Soon instead opens UpcomingView, with date selection, TV calendar sheet/adaptive mobile calendar, ordered interest/type filters, profile-local title hiding/restore and refresh recovery. UpcomingFeedLoader joins history-bearing shows, in-progress movies, Watchlist movies/shows and personal pending/approved Seerr movie/show requests without treating dates as availability. Custom rows can combine feeds through HomeContentPager, interleaving sources and merging matching copies. Their browser starts with the saved row query, but changes there remain temporary. Dedicated Discover instead uses DiscoverBrowseView/DiscoverRuntime in both shells, with ordered paged feeds and profile-saved Available now/Hide watched controls; its focused guide explains access, title actions and row recovery separately from Home hero discovery. Filtering/sorting waits for the full available Home row rather than sorting only the preview; server-feed identity and current profile visibility are retained. Name-sort rail behavior is TV-only; unused menu/observed feedback state is not a mobile jump control. Library presentation, collection covers and Home rows retain independent scopes and failure recovery. Account-wide history ignores disabled-library discovery. Both shells wire detail theme music and server trailers with lifecycle/authorization checks; online trailers open YouTube externally with mobile-only web fallback. The TV Home performance overlay supports stutter reporting, not a mobile overlay. Eligible Apple TV Home/detail server previews expand through Up with borrowed transport; Home requires Pinned Sidebar, and sound returns to the previous mute state afterward. Detail information groups expand into platform-specific readers; series catalogue totals are not available/unwatched counts.

FeatureLiveTV.summary: Cover reachable channel menus, previews, Multiviews, guide search/correction, source-scoped channel-identity review, local Kids playlist approvals and channel checks. The mobile destination wires the network policy into playback eligibility: Wi-Fi-only enforcement follows detected changes, while Low Data Mode independently pauses live playback until an unrestricted connection is available. Automatic library channels offer preparation Retry and ready-state Refresh, but no individual editing; custom channels retain their separate editor. Guide options reaches Review channel identities; confirmed historical identity is applied by the durable cache/import model and reuses saved preferences only when the old entry is absent. The playlist detail's SettingsPageLink reaches scanning; its global TV Sources destination is nested under library-channel management and unreliable. Source-copy import exists for legacy/fallback flows and syncs differently from current IPTV-account file imports; do not invent a universal alternate import procedure. Personal channel-label/preferences and the separate unavailable-favorite recovery helper have no prototype presentation route, so omit them as unusable controls without confusing them with the reachable identity review. Maintain the focused channel-organization sections, guide retention limits and source-to-IPTV-account migration; these are reachable workflows, unlike the retired personal channel editor. TV Sources/Add TV Source labels are shared with CoreUI; setup and source details expose persistent, authorized IPTV guide preparation and Refresh guide. Eligible Silo libraries participate in automatic/custom Plozz channels without supplying native Silo Live TV. Both app shells mount foreground, authorization-scoped refresh for saved IPTV account guides; it does not fetch first-use guides or schedule system background work. Clean channel names defaults on.

FeatureMusic.summary: Cover server-library listening on Apple TV and TestFlight/development mobile builds, not production mobile or offline downloads. Trace authorization, enabled libraries, compact dock/full-player navigation, adaptive transport, queue History/reordering/clearing and provider-owned ratings/favorites with failure recovery. Background audio and Now Playing are wired on both platforms. LRCLIB metadata privacy applies on both, but only the TV toggle disables future lookup; mobile Lyrics controls panel visibility. Last.fm is wired only by the TV shell. Full-player appearance and its platform-specific entry points remain part of the music reference, not a page per control.

FeaturePlayback.summary: Use task sections for player preferences, text/image/dual-subtitle limits, confirmed caption-style replacement and live rewind. Apple TV orders Audio, Subtitles, the current-rate Playback Speed button and More; More owns Zoom Mode, eligible Upscaling and nested Version. Mobile uses portrait Playback options or landscape Audio/Subtitles/speed plus Playback settings, without a Video submenu. Quality presets apply directly; Advanced… opens its sheet. Subtitles > Advanced… owns second-track, delay and appearance controls. Normal/Auto-crop black bars/Crop/Stretch/Custom framing has a 50%-200% custom range. Platform defaults start at Normal; Auto-crop is opt-in. Movie/series choices persist per profile independently of track memory and can follow strongly matched copies across servers; new live channels use the default without per-channel memory. Conditional session Upscaling reloads around the position without changing saved defaults. Audio Sync needs eligible AetherEngine retiming/seek support, including supported buffered live routes, not native-player support. Shipped engines omit engine-local dialogue processing; Apple TV's separate system bridge exposes output-gated global Enhance Dialogue/Reduce Loud Sounds and recovery. Movie audio-language choices are remembered automatically; series language needs its switch and neither stores an exact mix. Prefer lossless audio selects the AetherEngine adapter's lossless/surroundCompat request at each video/live load; native/external apps do not consume it and actual output is not guaranteed. Chapters needs source/file chapters; images are optional, seeking preserves pause intent and spoilers, and cast-page navigation ends playback. Default-on profile toggles gate Chapters, Cast, Episodes, Playlist and Continue Watching while Info remains. Continue Watching uses loaded Home progress, excludes the current item/same-source show episodes and prepares an authorized target source/version before saving progress and switching. Song identification defaults on, uses decoded audio rather than the microphone, requires internet and a supported route, and is unavailable offline/native/remote-bypass. Confirmed Info cards open the shared service chooser; TV failures offer phone QR links and mobile uses app/browser. Live TV buffer is a new-load cushion with latency/tuning tradeoffs, not library-file buffering. Diagnostics distinguish active conversion facts, originals, measured throughput, window/buffer and temporary cache without claiming speaker layout. Internal screenshot hooks expose no reader capture task. BorrowedTrailerPlayer gives an existing hero preview TV transport with speed/zoom but no provider session, tracks or history. Track labels retain meaningful names and regional/version distinctions; Commentary/Audio Description qualifiers and inferred-language auto are inventoried on TV/mobile parents and explained in Audio/Subtitles.

FeatureProfiles.summary: Cover profile setup, entry/edit authorization, Kids restrictions and device-local automatic sign-in. Apple TV's separate browsing-return policy is wired through foreground protection, profile flow and RootView: automatic sign-in off permits immediate protected-profile checks or a five-minute unprotected multi-profile timeout, excluding playback departures and inactive-only interruptions. Plex Home onboarding offers bulk import or Just me without authenticating other imported users; the brief import confirmation advances automatically to Choose your profile, while Just me opens Choose your Plex user. New profiles carry isAwaitingSetup and their own Home-user binding, not automatically a Kids flag. The selected viewer must still complete authorization and setup. The Forgot PIN strings in ProfileLockCopy have no presentation call site; both the shared entry PIN screen and management actions lack a reset control. Do not promise recovery from unused labels; another device must already have unlocked editing access before removing a synced lock.

FeatureSearch.summary: The library guide explains entering a title, opening results, and using the distinct mobile Clear search and Cancel search controls. Search covers enabled libraries under authorized server users, with connected Seerr supplying a separate Not in Your Library section. Shared card menus depend on item/provider permissions; plain search posters have no download badges or resume-chip captions. Consent-scoped diagnostics retain provider categories, counts, timing and request failures without query text, content names, URLs or provider identifiers; they are not retained search history.

FeatureSettings.summary: Group by task and platform/provider applicability, not by toggle. Preserve Home Rows/Add row, separate watched-content Filtering, current Home/Libraries/Movie & show details paths and TV navigation layouts/shortcut recovery. Add row > Custom row is a multi-source editor, not a collection-only shortcut. Its Content picker selects collections, video playlists, enabled video libraries, Home feeds and recommendations; the focused guide explains saved queries, non-playing previews, provider/user restrictions, unavailable-source recovery, TV autosave and explicit mobile/new-row saves. Landscape custom rows alone expose Logo On/Off after Layout, default Off. Keep shared Card labels, independent Logo/Text sizing, spoilers and classification controls distinct from restrictions. Collection-cover shapes have independent library/Recommended/Home scopes and do not style titles within collections. Detail music works in both shells; audio explains volume, preview/generated fallback and mobile session mute. Prefer lossless audio retains its output-compatibility section, default, device scope, new-load timing and hardware limits. Profiles covers TV/mobile server users and adding shared sign-ins without creating users. Skipping, independent buffers, saved-sign-in recovery and sync-data sizes stay in their tasks. Feedback explains Share Diagnostics, Enable Sharing without submission, Message (required), Send to Developer and Submitted's SDK-handoff limit, plus privacy and TV Home stutter measurements. Reload/reset are reachable in both sync troubleshooting UIs. External-player choice keeps device scope, eligibility, token sharing and returned progress in its focused guide. Developer Mode and Reset to First Run are deliberately hidden diagnostic/setup-retest surfaces gated by DeveloperModeModel, not routine recovery; omit their unlock/reset steps. Home hero and Movie & show details share Trailers & music: source policy, independent Home autoplay/detail background, conditional mute controls and theme-volume preview. Shared Default player zoom and Video upscaling controls are embedded in both Playback settings parents. Guide preferences adds foreground-only saved-IPTV refresh cadence; all shared labels and conditional controls are inventoried on the parents.

FeatureSyncCloud.summary: Separate settings/profile/media/tracker channels from encrypted provider credentials on both platforms and legacy mobile Keychain publication. First-run consent gates automatic sync. Existing sign-ins without publication ownership require the authorized post-setup Save Sign-ins to iCloud? choice; declining leaves settings sync enabled. Publication ownership is bound to the verified iCloud account and exact sign-in, not shared playback access. Account changes and stale prompt responses cannot authorize credential export. Temporary iCloud unavailability retains saved state and reports retry advice; local capture failures remain visible without representing absent data as deletion. Restoration Retry/Set up manually is not destructive reset. Profile snapshots carry Watchlist browse preferences and the seriesTrackPreferences store, including remembered movie audio languages and movie/series zoom. Device-specific density, main navigation, accidental-exit prevention, the retired detail-transition key and lossless-audio choices are excluded. Upcoming hidden titles and Live TV view preferences are also absent from the allowlist. Offline Mode pauses mobile cloud and credential updates. Live TV source data is encrypted; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local. Keep local data-breakdown exclusions, schedule-catalogue prerequisites, and reset/erase warnings.
